### OpenRegister reliance

**light**: this component touches OpenRegister lightly. 1 direct reference, 1 file reached through imports.

See the [reliance overview](./index.md#openregister-reliance) for the filterable list.

| `register`    | `string`             |          | `''`                                         | Register slug or id. Empty: read from `objectData['@self'].register`.      |
| `schema`      | `string`             |          | `''`                                         | Schema slug or id. Empty: read from `objectData['@self'].schema`.          |
| `objectId`    | `string&#124;number` |          | `''`                                         | Object id. Empty: read from `objectData['@self'].id`.                      |
| `objectData`  | `object`             |          | `\{\}`                                       | The loaded object; its `@self` supplies the context the props leave empty. |

| `apiBase`     | `string`             |          | `'/apps/openregister/api/objects'`           | Object API base (before `/{register}/{schema}/{id}/files`).                |
